authors: Jakob Günther; Freek Witteveen; Alexander Schmidhuber; Marek Miller; Matthias Christandl; Aram Harrow
title: Phase estimation with partially randomized time evolution
locus: Sec IV Eqs 22–26; Lemma A.1 Eqs A14–A17 PDF p20; Lemma A.3 Eq A41 p23; App A.4 Eqs A43–A46 p24; Thm B.2 pp27–29; App E Eqs E12,E20–E23 pp40–43
task: Hadamard/RPE ground-energy estimation, fully randomized qDRIFT and partially randomized RTE
known: qDRIFT exact first moment and arctan energy correction; guiding-overlap RPE RMS bounds; independent RTE draws in ± branches; deterministic-only halving; native/HWP resource model
boundary: These located partial-randomization theorems use RTE. A theorem for noncommuting interleaved qDRIFT with all M1 signal/gap/overlap conditions was not identified in the checked sections.

title: Composite Quantum Simulations
locus: Sec 3.2 Def 3 Eq27 and Thm4 Eqs28–29 p8; Sec4.1 Thm5 p9; higher-order Thm2.1 pp3,13
known: Hamiltonian partition, channel diamond-norm error and exponential-query cost
boundary: The reported bound is channel error, not a direct statement of M1 coherent Hadamard/RPE phase stability. Any application to a lifted controlled problem is a further mapping, not performed here.

authors: Matthew Pocrnic; Matthew Hagan; Juan Carrasquilla; Dvira Segal; Nathan Wiebe
title: Composite QDrift-Product Formulas for Quantum and Classical Simulations in Real and Imaginary Time
locus: Sec II D–E Eqs11–16 pp6–7; Sec III ThmsIII.1–III.3; local composite Thm9 p16
task: Real/imaginary-time composite channels, local decompositions and finite-model gate counts
known: qDRIFT plus deterministic block construction and channel-norm/imaginary-time bounds
boundary: Not an explicit matching coherent/RPE phase-bias theorem for M1; imaginary-time results are a different physical task.

authors: Shota Kanasugi; Riki Toshio; Kazunori Maruyama; Hirotaka Oshima
title: Enabling Chemically Accurate Quantum Phase Estimation in the Early Fault-Tolerant Regime
locus: Sec II B.2 Eqs10–13 pp4–5; II B.3–4 Eqs14–18 pp5–6; App A pp20–21; App B EqsB1–B5 p21
task: Early-FT STAR/UWC and partially randomized RPE cost model
known: qDRIFT signal model, partially randomized resource accounting, gamma=1 qDRIFT versus gamma=2 RTE/TE-PAI; Cgate=1 STAR rotations

title: Quantum algorithms for molecular electronic structure
version: University of Copenhagen PDF, title-page June 2025; repository award/publication 2025-10-02
locus: Ch2 pp47–119; Sec2.4/2.5 pp59–66; Sec2.9 qDRIFT pp77–79, partial RTE pp82–84, ±control p85; Sec2.10 pp116–119; Table2.2 p119
task: Molecular phase estimation; embedded PR study and extra resource results
known: Same qDRIFT and partial-RTE distinction; independent randomness at p85; correction of resource-code prefactors in Sec2.10; saved deterministic/total cost fractions
boundary: Ch2 largely reproduces the earlier PR preprint, not independent replication and not identical to PR v2. Aggregate FeMoco cost ratios are not Track A long-round measurements.

title: A random compiler for fast Hamiltonian simulation
locus: Main qDRIFT channel/error analysis; App D EqD1 p8; App E phase-estimation resource analysis pp8–10
task: Random compiler, channel simulation and controlled QPE implementation
known: qDRIFT and controlled-Hamiltonian construction are prior art
boundary: Does not establish in the inspected portions the same claimed interleaved-qDRIFT M1 signal theorem. Do not infer novelty solely from avoiding the original diamond bound.

authors: Yanwu Gu; Yunheng Ma; Nicolò Forcellini; Dong E. Liu
title: Noise-resilient phase estimation with randomized compiling
locus: Main Thm1 p2; included SI Sec I EqsS7–S8 p8, SecII EqsS11–S16 p9
task: Control-free phase estimation of a noisy unitary channel
known: Hermitian Kraus noise gives no first-order phase shift; isolation-distance perturbation condition and left/right eigenoperator signal expansion are also provided.
boundary: Unitary-channel eigenoperators and coherent amplitude mean are different objects; M1 reduction to this theorem is not proved here. First-order phase insensitivity is not new by itself.

title: Some Error Analysis for the Quantum Phase Estimation Algorithms
locus: Thm2.2 p8; Thm3.1 p11; Sec4 Eqs40–56 pp12–16, Thm4.1 p16
task: Register-based QPE with imperfect state/unitary and random-unitary approximations
boundary: A register-QPE success bound is not automatically the M1 single-ancilla multi-round signal theorem. Whether an existing result implies the proposed guarantee is unresolved.

authors: Davide Cugini; Touheed Anwar Atif; Yigit Subasi
title: Resource-Optimal Importance Sampling for Randomized Quantum Algorithms
locus: Sec II Thm1 Eqs4–13 pp2–3; Sec II.1; qDRIFT application
task: Observable estimation with a fixed implementable ensemble and weighted outcomes
known: Cost–worst-case-second-moment optimization by classical change of proposal
boundary: No replacement for a theorem on M1 energy/phase bias when the physical ensemble is changed.
